claims.text: $106.3M awarded and committed across three public awards; the headline's $106 million (H1, hero figure, meta description).
claims.assert: D['meta']['totals']['total'] == 106290451 and D['meta']['totals']['awards'] + D['meta']['totals']['match'] == D['meta']['totals']['total'] and abs(D['meta']['totals']['total'] / 1e6 - 106.3) <= 0.05
claims.falsified_if: Any award or match figure revises, so the hand-typed $106.3M and the $106 million headline no longer round from the data.

claims.text: $85.3M in awards plus $21.0M in match and cost share (hero sub-line; the verdict's $85.3M; the table foots against $85,335,784).
claims.assert: D['meta']['totals']['awards'] == 85335784 and D['meta']['totals']['match'] == 20954667 and abs(D['meta']['totals']['awards'] / 1e6 - 85.3) <= 0.05 and abs(D['meta']['totals']['match'] / 1e6 - 21.0) <= 0.05
claims.falsified_if: Either total revises so the hand-typed $85.3M or $21.0M no longer rounds from the data.

claims.text: The three masthead tiles: $51.00M + $7.16M partner match; $31.25M + $10.42M state cost share; $3.08M + $3.37M local match (hand-typed; the machine kickers repeat the award figures).
claims.assert: (lambda s: s['award'] == 51001413 and s['matchAmount'] == 7164030)(one(x for x in D['sources'] if x['id'] == 'eda')) and (lambda s: s['award'] == 31250000 and s['matchAmount'] == 10417066)(one(x for x in D['sources'] if x['id'] == 'ohio')) and (lambda s: s['award'] == 3084371 and s['matchAmount'] == 3373571)(one(x for x in D['sources'] if x['id'] == 'apex'))
claims.actual: [(s['id'], s['award'], s['matchAmount']) for s in D['sources']]
claims.falsified_if: Any of the six figures revises, so a hand-typed tile or machine kicker no longer matches its award.

claims.text: Three awards, three machines: seven direct federal awards, one state grant split into five workstreams, one workforce award (H1, standfirst, machines section, map lede).
claims.assert: len(D['sources']) == 3 and len([w for r in D['recipients'] for w in r['awards'] if w['programId'] == 'eda-direct']) == 7 and len([p for p in D['programs'] if p['sourceId'] == 'ohio']) == 5 and len([p for p in D['programs'] if p['sourceId'] == 'apex']) == 1
claims.actual: (len(D['sources']), len([w for r in D['recipients'] for w in r['awards'] if w['programId'] == 'eda-direct']), len([p for p in D['programs'] if p['sourceId'] == 'ohio']), len([p for p in D['programs'] if p['sourceId'] == 'apex']))
claims.falsified_if: A source, workstream or direct award is added or removed, so 'three machines', 'seven awards' or 'splits five ways' stops being the count.

claims.text: Largest federal check: BioVerde, $11.12M, for bio-based butadiene (machine 1 fact).
claims.assert: (lambda rows: sorted(rows, key=lambda x: -x[1])[0] == ('BioVerde', 11122386))([(r['name'], w['amount']) for r in D['recipients'] for w in r['awards'] if w['programId'] == 'eda-direct']) and 'butadiene' in one(w for r in D['recipients'] if r['name'] == 'BioVerde' for w in r['awards'] if w['programId'] == 'eda-direct')['funds'].lower()
claims.actual: sorted([(r['name'], w['amount']) for r in D['recipients'] for w in r['awards'] if w['programId'] == 'eda-direct'], key=lambda x: -x[1])[:2]
claims.falsified_if: Another EDA award tops $11,122,386, or the BioVerde figure or project description revises.

claims.text: The single largest line on the map is the $18.52M pilot facility, a building (A1 annotation, machine 2 sentence, the verdict, the cards-view scale note).
claims.source: maximum single award across all recipients; oh-facility program amount
claims.assert: max(w['amount'] for r in D['recipients'] for w in r['awards']) == 18521985 and one(p for p in D['programs'] if p['id'] == 'oh-facility')['amount'] == 18521985 and max(p['amount'] for p in D['programs'] if p['sourceId'] == 'ohio') == 18521985
claims.actual: sorted([w['amount'] for r in D['recipients'] for w in r['awards']])[-3:]
claims.falsified_if: Any award exceeds $18,521,985, or the facility line revises, so 'the single largest line is a building' stops being true.

claims.text: Nine startups share $225K in cash, $25K each (A2 annotation, startup group sub-line, machine 2's fourteen organizations).
claims.assert: (lambda ws: len(ws) == 9 and set(ws) == {25000} and sum(ws) == 225000)([w['amount'] for r in D['recipients'] for w in r['awards'] if w['programId'] == 'oh-startup'])
claims.actual: [w['amount'] for r in D['recipients'] for w in r['awards'] if w['programId'] == 'oh-startup']
claims.falsified_if: The cohort gains or loses a company, or any cash award moves off $25,000.

claims.text: The seven federal leads hold $51.00M (A2 annotation line two; machine 1; the EDA tile).
claims.assert: (lambda ws: len(ws) == 7 and sum(ws) == 51001413)([w['amount'] for r in D['recipients'] for w in r['awards'] if w['programId'] == 'eda-direct'])
claims.actual: (len([w for r in D['recipients'] for w in r['awards'] if w['programId'] == 'eda-direct']), sum(w['amount'] for r in D['recipients'] for w in r['awards'] if w['programId'] == 'eda-direct'))
claims.falsified_if: An EDA award is added, removed or revised, so the seven no longer sum to $51,001,413.

claims.text: Of the $85.3M awarded, $79.2M has reached a named recipient; $6.17M has not (verdict sentence, A3 annotation, table foot).
claims.assert: (lambda s: s == 79170176 and D['meta']['totals']['awards'] - s == 6165608 and abs(s / 1e6 - 79.2) <= 0.05)(sum(w['amount'] for r in D['recipients'] for w in r['awards']))
claims.actual: (sum(w['amount'] for r in D['recipients'] for w in r['awards']), D['meta']['totals']['awards'] - sum(w['amount'] for r in D['recipients'] for w in r['awards']))
claims.falsified_if: A new sub-grant executes or an award revises, so the named-recipient sum leaves $79,170,176 and $79.2M / $6.17M stop rounding from the data.

claims.text: The unrouted money splits into $2.64M of Translational R&D not yet sub-granted and $3.52M running Synthe6 through Bounce (A3 annotation; reconciliation notes).
claims.source: program amounts minus their executed sub-awards
claims.assert: (lambda rd, s6: one(p for p in D['programs'] if p['id'] == 'oh-rd')['amount'] - rd == 2642108 and one(p for p in D['programs'] if p['id'] == 'oh-startup')['amount'] - s6 == 3523500)(sum(w['amount'] for r in D['recipients'] for w in r['awards'] if w['programId'] == 'oh-rd'), sum(w['amount'] for r in D['recipients'] for w in r['awards'] if w['programId'] == 'oh-startup'))
claims.actual: (one(p for p in D['programs'] if p['id'] == 'oh-rd')['amount'] - sum(w['amount'] for r in D['recipients'] for w in r['awards'] if w['programId'] == 'oh-rd'), one(p for p in D['programs'] if p['id'] == 'oh-startup')['amount'] - sum(w['amount'] for r in D['recipients'] for w in r['awards'] if w['programId'] == 'oh-startup'))
claims.falsified_if: A new Translational sub-grant executes or a workstream budget revises, so either balance moves.

claims.text: More than half of the awarded money sits with the seven direct federal awardees (verdict sentence).
claims.assert: (lambda e, t: e > 0.55 * t)(sum(w['amount'] for r in D['recipients'] for w in r['awards'] if w['programId'] == 'eda-direct'), D['meta']['totals']['awards'])
claims.actual: sum(w['amount'] for r in D['recipients'] for w in r['awards'] if w['programId'] == 'eda-direct') / D['meta']['totals']['awards']
claims.falsified_if: The EDA share of awarded money falls to 55% or below - the sentence says 'more than half' and currently reads 59.8%.

claims.text: $3.35M executed so far in seven Translational R&D sub-grants (band rider; reconciliation note keeps the full figure).
claims.assert: (lambda ws: len(ws) == 7 and sum(ws) == 3349892 and abs(sum(ws) / 1e6 - 3.35) <= 0.005)([w['amount'] for r in D['recipients'] for w in r['awards'] if w['programId'] == 'oh-rd'])
claims.actual: (len([w for r in D['recipients'] for w in r['awards'] if w['programId'] == 'oh-rd']), sum(w['amount'] for r in D['recipients'] for w in r['awards'] if w['programId'] == 'oh-rd'))
claims.falsified_if: An eighth sub-grant executes or a figure revises, so '$3.35M' or 'seven' stops matching.

claims.text: Three machines, twenty-one recipients (figure title; meta description's 'seven programs, twenty-one recipients').
claims.falsified_if: A recipient or program is added or removed and the hand-typed counts go stale.

claims.text: The Ohio hub's two company-facing slices, Translational R&D and Synthe6, reach fourteen organizations (machine 2 fact).
claims.source: distinct recipients holding an oh-rd or oh-startup award
claims.assert: len(set(r['id'] for r in D['recipients'] for w in r['awards'] if w['programId'] in ('oh-rd', 'oh-startup'))) == 14
claims.actual: sorted(set(r['id'] for r in D['recipients'] for w in r['awards'] if w['programId'] in ('oh-rd', 'oh-startup')))
claims.falsified_if: A sub-grant or cohort change moves the distinct-organization count off fourteen.

claims.text: APEX training aims at 500 enrollments and 320 placements, and the $3.37M local match commitment is larger than the $3.08M award itself (machine 3).
claims.source: apex-workforce award funds string; apex source award vs matchAmount
claims.assert: '500 enrollments and 320 placements' in one(w for r in D['recipients'] for w in r['awards'] if w['programId'] == 'apex-workforce')['funds'] and (lambda s: s['matchAmount'] > s['award'])(one(x for x in D['sources'] if x['id'] == 'apex'))
claims.actual: (one(w for r in D['recipients'] for w in r['awards'] if w['programId'] == 'apex-workforce')['funds'], one(x for x in D['sources'] if x['id'] == 'apex')['matchAmount'], one(x for x in D['sources'] if x['id'] == 'apex')['award'])
claims.falsified_if: The enrollment targets change in the award record, or a match revision drops the commitment to or below the award.

claims.text: Flexsys holds $10.09M for a safer anti-degradant, a 6PPD alternative (vignette kicker and body).
claims.assert: (lambda w: w['amount'] == 10093286 and '6PPD' in w['funds'])(one(w for r in D['recipients'] if r['id'] == 'flexsys' for w in r['awards']))
claims.actual: one(w for r in D['recipients'] if r['id'] == 'flexsys' for w in r['awards'])
claims.falsified_if: The Flexsys figure revises off $10,093,286 or the award stops being described as a 6PPD alternative.

claims.text: Full Circle Technologies holds $4.70M, the only recycling project among the seven direct federal awards (vignette).
claims.assert: (lambda ws: len([w for w in ws if 'ecycling' in w['funds']]) == 1 and one(w for w in ws if 'ecycling' in w['funds'])['amount'] == 4702500)([w for r in D['recipients'] for w in r['awards'] if w['programId'] == 'eda-direct' and w.get('funds')])
claims.actual: [(w['funds'], w['amount']) for r in D['recipients'] for w in r['awards'] if w['programId'] == 'eda-direct']
claims.falsified_if: A second EDA award is described as recycling, or the Full Circle figure revises off $4,702,500.

claims.text: The hand-typed 'as of 13 August 2026' in the methods section and the figure source line matches the data vintage.
claims.falsified_if: The data refresh to a newer vintage while the hand-typed dates still say 13 August 2026.

claims.text: 6PPD-quinone, 6PPD's breakdown product, was identified in a 2021 Science paper as the chemical killing coho salmon in urban Pacific Northwest streams; 6PPD is used in nearly every tire (Flexsys vignette).
claims.source: Tian et al., 'A ubiquitous tire rubber-derived chemical induces acute mortality in coho salmon', Science 371(6525):185-189 (2021), doi:10.1126/science.abd6951; citation web-verified against science.org on 2026-08-27
claims.falsified_if: The 6PPD-quinone attribution is retracted or materially revised, or 6PPD stops being the industry-standard tire anti-degradant.

claims.text: A tire is mostly vulcanized rubber and cannot be melted back down the way a thermoplastic bottle can (Full Circle vignette).
claims.source: Standard polymer chemistry: sulfur vulcanization crosslinks are not melt-reprocessable; tires are elastomer composites with steel and fabric reinforcement, hence 'mostly'.
claims.falsified_if: A materials reviewer disputes the thermoset characterization as stated.

claims.text: Every detail panel states that disbursement to date is not public on this page (panel disclosure line).
claims.source: funding-map/README.md sub-award disclosure ruling: disbursement figures are internal and must not be published here; award-level federal outlays exist on USAspending.gov but are not shipped with this page.
claims.falsified_if: The disclosure ruling changes and outlay figures are added to the page, at which point the panels must show them instead of the line.
